text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following two Council Members to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors for a term starting at the Annual meeting in May 2018 to the Annual Meeting in May 2019: - Councillor Josh Colle - Councillor Norman Kelly
